Subject: Plan smoothing & temporary seat uplift

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. A couple things came up in our internal ops sync that I want to get clarity on before we talk numbers:

1) We expect a short spike (approx +45% tokens) during our campaign in mid-Oct — we'd like the option to temporarily add 30 seats for two weeks without a long-term reprice. Is there a clean way to do a temporary uplift and automatic reversion?

2) Our product team is concerned about feature parity between your Compact plan and Core plan: specifically function-calls and structured output support. If we choose Compact + add-ons, can we guarantee parity for the call patterns we showed?

3) Lastly, can you share an amortized price example for a quarterly commit with a blended discount if we commit to Dedicated capacity for 6 months? The procurement team will need a worked example.

I've attached our Aug usage slice and a short summary of the expected campaign window. Looking forward to a short proposal and timing.

Best,
Ethan
Director, Platform Integrations
NovaCare

Attachments: NovaCare_usage_report_Aug2026.csv

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Plan smoothing & temporary seat uplift

Ethan —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and Karthik/Marcus are looped for pricing and capacity detail.

- Temporary uplifts: yes — we offer a two-week seat-burst mechanism on both Hosted and Dedicated. It can be configured as either pre-approved (one-click burst up to X seats) or request-based with auto-reversion. For a +30 seats two-week window we can do it without changing the committed tier; cost is metered at the burst rate and invoiced after the window.

- Feature parity: Compact + the Functionality Add-on covers function-calls and structured output. For models that use heavy tool-calling we recommend the Core plan or Compact+Add-on with a small rate-limited proxy — avoids cold-cache latency during the spike. We'll include a compatibility checklist for your call patterns.

- Amortized pricing: Karthik will send a worked example (monthly amortized rate across a 6-month Dedicated commit) and a blended discount schedule. Marcus will propose a fallback routing plan if Dedicated capacity hits limits during the campaign.

I'll follow up with a short proposal and attachments.

—Stephanie
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Stephanie / Marcus —

Quick pricing notes for the proposal doc:

- Baseline: NovaCare current average monthly tokens (from attached CSV) = ~120M tokens / mo. Campaign peak ~170M tokens for two weeks.

- Option A (Hosted, short commit): No reserved capacity; burst metering only. Burst rate = baseline * 1.6 for the two-week uplift. No discount beyond usage tiers.

- Option B (6mo Dedicated commit): Commit to 150k GPU-hours / mo (estimated to cover median load) with a 12% blended discount off Hosted retail; includes a "seat-burst allowance" of up to 25% above commit per month at +30% incremental surcharge. For the specific two-week uplift, amortized incremental cost = $12k (approx) billed after month close.

- Option C (Compact + Functionality Add-on): Lower base token price, add-on flat fee covers function-calls routing and structured output. Recommend this only if they accept a conservative latency SLO; otherwise Core plan.

Discount negotiation: I'd recommend starting with 10% on top of the listed 12% for a 6mo commit if they sign within two weeks and agree to the seat-burst pre-approval. Gives us margin to accept final 12%.

Attachments: I've added a SKU matrix (Redwood_SKU_matrix_v3.xlsx) into the shared Drive link. Marcus — can you confirm routing fallback and the auto-reversion timeline for the burst?

—Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering

Ethan / Team —

Thanks for the patience — attaching a short proposal and three packaged options tailored to the campaign window: Hosted Burst, 6mo Dedicated Commit (with seat-burst allowance), Compact+Functionality Add-on. Key bullets below:

- Hosted Burst: zero commit, pay-as-you-go. Good for one-off spikes; estimated uplift cost = $14,200 for two-week spike. No contractual change.

- 6mo Dedicated Commit (recommended): 12% discount off Hosted list; amortized monthly cost example included. Includes pre-approved seat-burst up to +30 seats for two weeks; auto-reversion occurs 48 hours after window close. If burst sustained >14 days, surcharge applies at +30% over committed rate for overflow.

- Compact + Add-on: +$3,500/mo add-on to enable function-calls parity (soft SLO). Lower token unit price but potential cold-cache latency during sudden spikes.

We also included a 30-day early-signature incentive: additional 2% discount if NovaCare signs the 6mo commit and pre-approves the burst policy by Sep 18.

Attached: Redwood_SKU_matrix_v3.xlsx; NovaCare_campaign_pricing_v2.pdf
